The material.

mesh.description:
The mesh.

MeshRenderer.title: MeshRenderer

Mobility.description:
How a mesh moves, a hint for virtual shadow maps' cache (M4 4.7b). A wrong hint never
changes the picture, only the cost.

oneOf.description: Dynamic while it has moved in the last 60 frames, static otherwise.

Kept in the static pages even when it moves (each move redraws them): for things that
move once.
Drawn into the dynamic pages from its first frame: doors, platforms, projectiles.

Mobility.title: Mobility

description: How an entity is drawn by distance from the camera: in full, then `instanced`, then not at all.

hidden_from.description: Meters from the camera where nothing is drawn (at least `instanced_from`).

instanced.description:
The cheaper mesh and material drawn from `instanced_from` (unskinned; it stands for every
part of a character). None: drawn in full until hidden.

instanced_from.description: Meters from the camera where the cheaper mesh takes over.
